	span = 1
	if value['display']['showAsset']: span += 1 
	if value['display']['showOrder']: span += 1
	
	cols = []
	
	cols.append({"title": "Total", "span": span, "justify": "right", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "", "backgroundColor": "--kcSurfaceVariant", "fontWeight": "bold"}})
	
	count = str(int(system.math.sum([item['value'] for item in value['countInfo'] if item['value'] is not None])))
	cols.append({"title": count, "span": 1, "justify": "right", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "", "backgroundColor": "--kcSurfaceVariant", "fontWeight": "bold"}})
	
	if value['display']['showTime']:
		totalLaborSecs = system.math.sum([item['earnedLaborSecs'] for item in value['countInfo'] if item['earnedLaborSecs'] is not None])
		totalLaborSecs = system.kanoa.utilities.secondsToText(totalLaborSecs, {'showDays': False, 'showSecs': False, 'showDays': False}) if totalLaborSecs > 0 else '0'
		cols.append({"title": totalLaborSecs, "span": 1, "justify": "right", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "", "backgroundColor": "--kcSurfaceVariant", "fontWeight": "bold"}})
	
	return [cols]

def buildColumn(field, visible, title, width, strictWidth):
		return {
				    "field": field,
				    "visible": visible,
				    "editable": False,
				    "render": "auto",
				    "justify": "right",
				    "align": "center",
				    "resizable": True,
				    "sortable": False,
				    "sort": "none",
				    "filter": {"enabled": False, "visible": "on-hover", "string": {"condition": "", "value": ""},
				      "number": {"condition": "", "value": ""},
				      "boolean": {"condition": ""},
				      "date": {"condition": "", "value": ""}
				    },
				    "viewPath": "",
				    "viewParams": {},
				    "boolean": "checkbox",
				    "number": "value",
				    "progressBar": {"max": 100, "min": 0, "bar": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "track": {"color": "", "style": {"classes": ""}}, "value": {"enabled": True, "format": "0,0.##", "justify": "center", "style": {"classes": ""}}},
				    "toggleSwitch": {"color": {"selected": "", "unselected": ""}},
				    "nullFormat": {"includeNullStrings": False, "strict": False, "nullFormatValue": ""},
				    "numberFormat": "0,0.##",
				    "dateFormat": "MM/DD/YYYY",
				    "width": width,
				    "strictWidth": strictWidth,
				    "header": {"title": title, "justify": "right", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": ""}},
				    "footer": {"title": "", "justify": "left", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": ""}},
				    "style": {"classes": ""}
				  }
	
	cols = []
	cols.append(buildColumn('assetId', False, 'assetId', '', False))
	cols.append(buildColumn('assetPath', False, 'assetPath', '', False))
	if value['showAsset']: cols.append(buildColumn('assetName', True, 'Asset', '', False))
	if value['showOrder']: cols.append(buildColumn('itemName', True, 'Order/Item', '', False))
	if True: cols.append(buildColumn('itemState', True, 'Counter', '', False))
	if True: cols.append(buildColumn('itemValue', True, 'Count', '', False))
	if value['showTime']: cols.append(buildColumn('earnedLaborValue', True, 'Earned Time', '', False))
	
	return cols

system.perspective.print('openCountEditor() called')
	params = dict(self.view.params.values.filter)
	if len(self.view.custom.table.selection.data) > 0:
		params['assetId'] = self.view.custom.table.selection.data[0].assetId
		params['assetPath'] = self.view.custom.table.selection.data[0].assetPath
	
#	title = '%s Count Editor'%system.kanoa.utilities.formatPath(params['assetPath'], {})
	title = 'Count Editor'
	
	system.perspective.openPopup('countViewer', 'kanoa/mes/asset/counts/countEditor', {'value': params}, title=title, resizable=True, draggable=True, showCloseIcon=True, viewPortBound=True)
	system.perspective.sendMessage("countParamsChanged", params)
	
	return
